title: AboutMe: Using Self-Descriptions in Webpages to Document the Effects of English Pretraining Data Filters
reasoning: The paper investigates the effects of data curation filters on the social and geographic representation of LLM pretraining data. While it includes 'religion' as one of the 50 topical clusters analyzed to check for filtering rates, its primary focus is on documenting data bias and filtering implications rather than evaluating religious content, spiritual traditions, or ethical reasoning.
